headline: TransDigm Announces Acquisition of Prince & Izant
summary: TransDigm Group Incorporated (NYSE: TDG) today announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Prince & Izant ("P&I" or "the Company"), a portfolio company of Industrial Growth Partners, for approximately $1.066 billion in cash, including certain tax benefits.
